key_insight: TraceFEM provides provable error control for coupled surface Stokes–Cahn–Hilliard dynamics, including phase-field maximum-norm estimates on two-dimensional surfaces.
engineering_relevance: The analysis supports reliable finite element simulation of coupled viscous flow and phase separation on surfaces.
method: Discretize space with TraceFEM and stabilization that filters out Killing vector fields.
Establish inf-sup equivalence and derive energy- and L²-norm error estimates.
Introduce p-dependent normal-derivative stabilization for new approximation and inverse estimates.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments corroborate the theoretical analysis; the abstract reports no quantitative error values.
watch_item: The analysis assumes no geometric error, so additional care is needed when using approximated surface geometry.
paper_title: Analysis of TraceFEM for the Surface Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard Model
